lines.beaver: 어제 민호 씨랑 서연 씨가 크게 다퉜대요.
lines.beaver_en: I heard Minho and Seoyeon had a big fight yesterday.
lines.beaver_roman: eoje minho ssirang seoyeon ssiga keuge datwotdaeyo.
lines.learner: 들었어요. 서연 씨가 항의하다가 말다툼이 됐죠?
lines.en: I heard. Seoyeon protested and it became an argument, right?
lines.roman: deureosseoyo. seoyeon ssiga hangihadaga maldatumi dwaetjyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 서연 씨는 민호 씨한테 속았다고 화를 냈어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, Seoyeon got angry, saying Minho deceived her.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, seoyeon ssineun minho ssihante sogatdago hwareul naesseoyo.
lines.learner: 정말 속였을까요? 오해가 있었던 것 같아요.
lines.en: Did he really deceive her? I think there was a misunderstanding.
lines.roman: jeongmal sogyeosseulkkayo? ohaega isseotdeon geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: Was there a misunderstanding? I don't know the details.
lines.learner: 거짓이 아니라 실수였대요. 일정을 잘못 들었대요.
lines.en: It wasn't a lie, it was a mistake. He misheard the schedule.
lines.roman: geojisi anira silsuyeotdaeyo. iljeongeul jalmot deureotdaeyo.

lines.beaver: 그런데 서연 씨는 그 말을 안 믿어요.
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde seoyeon ssineun geu mareul an mideoyo.
lines.learner: 변명이나 핑계로 들렸나 봐요. 불만이 쌓였겠네요.
lines.en: It must have sounded like an excuse. Her frustration must have built up.
lines.roman: byeonmyeongina pinggyero deullyeonna bwayo. bulmani ssayeotgenneyo.

lines.beaver: 민호 씨는 서연 씨 잔소리가 심하대요.
lines.beaver_en: Minho says Seoyeon nags too much.
lines.beaver_roman: minho ssineun seoyeon ssi jansoriga simhadaeyo.
lines.en: If it feels like pressure or meddling, it's easy to push back.

lines.beaver: 심지어 욕까지 할 뻔해서 제가 말렸어요.
lines.beaver_en: They almost even swore, so I stopped them.
lines.beaver_roman: simjieo yokkkaji hal ppeonhaeseo jega mallyeosseoyo.
lines.learner: 잘 말렸어요. 싸움은 일에도 방해가 돼요.
lines.en: Good that you stopped them. Fights get in the way of work too.
lines.roman: jal mallyeosseoyo. ssaumeun iredo banghaega dwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 팀장님이 알면 둘 다 꾸중 들을 거예요. 어떻게 하죠?
lines.beaver_en: If the manager finds out, they'll both get scolded. What should we do?
lines.beaver_roman: timjangnimi almyeon dul da kkujung deureul geoyeyo. eotteoke hajyo?
lines.learner: 서연 씨 화가 풀리거든 대화해 보라고 해요.
lines.en: Once Seoyeon calms down, tell her to try talking.
lines.roman: seoyeon ssi hwaga pulligeodeun daehwahae borago haeyo.

lines.beaver: 민호 씨는 화가 나서 복수하겠다고 해요.
lines.beaver_en: Minho is angry and says he'll get revenge.
lines.beaver_roman: minho ssineun hwaga naseo boksuhagetdago haeyo.
lines.learner: 복수는 안 돼요. 서로 나무라면 갈등만 커져요.
lines.en: No revenge. If they blame each other, the conflict only grows.
lines.roman: boksuneun an dwaeyo. seoro namuramyeon galdeungman keojyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 둘이 어떻게 화해할 수 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: Then how can the two of them make up?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom duri eotteoke hwahaehal su isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 민호 씨가 미안하거든 먼저 사과하라고 하세요.
lines.en: If Minho feels sorry, tell him to apologize first.
lines.roman: minho ssiga mianhageodeun meonjeo sagwaharago haseyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 오늘 점심때 둘을 같이 불러 볼게요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay. I'll invite them both to lunch today.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. oneul jeomsimttae dureul gachi bulleo bolgeyo.
lines.learner: 화해하면 좋겠네요. 저도 시간 되거든 갈게요.
lines.en: I hope they make up. I'll come too if I have time.
lines.roman: hwahaehamyeon jokenneyo. jeodo sigan doegeodeun galgeyo.
